articles.title: Tennessee National Guard fatally shot 20-year-old armed man in the back, autopsy shows
articles.description: An autopsy shows that an armed man killed by the Tennessee National Guard was shot in the back. The report that Tyrin Johnson’s family shared with The Associated Press on Thursday contradicts accounts by law enforcement. Authorities said the troops were running after Johnson in the early morning hours after the Fourth of July holiday in Memphis when he turned toward them and two guardsmen fired at him. The guard members were part of the Memphis Safe Task Force and assigned to work alongside federal, state and local authorities to address crime. Johnson’s grandfather says the guard members had no justification to shoot his grandson in the back.

articles.title: 11 terrorists killed in intelligence-based operations in KP, Balochistan
articles.description: Security forces killed 11 terrorists during intelligence-based operations (IBOs) in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, state-run Radio Pakistan reported on Thursday, citing security sources. According to the state broadcaster, the terrorists belonged to Fitna al Khawarij and Fitna al Hindustan . The state uses the term Fitna al Khawarij for the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) and refers to designated Balochistan-based groups as Fitna al Hindustan to highlight India’s role in terrorism and destabilisation across Pakistan. “In Bannu, security forces conducted an IBO against Fitna al Khawarij , killing two terrorists and recovering weapons and ammunition,” Radio Pakistan reported. In the Ladha area of South Waziristan, five Khawarij terrorists were killed during an operation, it added. Meanwhile, four terrorists belonging to Fitna al Hindustan were killed in the Sasool area of Khuzdar district, it said. “Security forces effectively targeted Fitna al Hindustan terrorists with the assistance of [a] quadcopter,” the report said. Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi paid tribute to the security forces for their successful operations against the terrorists, according to a statement issued by his ministry. He said that security forces had thwarted the terrorists’ nefarious designs by taking timely action. The minister said the nation stood united against terrorism and in solidarity with the security forces. On Aug 21, the military’s media affairs wing said security forces eliminated 49 terrorists in separate IBOs in KP and Balochistan. According to the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies , an Islamabad-based think tank, violence linked to terrorist attacks and counterterrorism operations intensified sharply in July, making it the deadliest month of 2026, with 112 security personnel among 205 people killed. According to the report, the security situation deteriorated most significantly in Balochistan, where the overall death toll increased by 241 per cent, from 109 in June to 372 in July, followed closely by mainland KP, which recorded 154 deaths in July, compared with 75 in June, representing an increase of 105pc.

articles.title: Trump's Reflecting Pool disaster devolves as sealant 'chunks' begin to break loose: report
articles.description: Sealant is breaking loose from the bottom of the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool again, this time during the repair work that President Donald Trump promised would fix the monument. Freelance photographer Joe Flood posted video of the loose sealant on X on Wednesday. Repair crews were at work on the liner on Aug. 18, according to the Washington Post . The basin has been drained for the work. "Sealant is coming up in chunks at the Reflecting Pool," Flood wrote. The pool has been drained and patched repeatedly since June, according to PBS News . The blue coating started peeling within days of the June refill, CNN reported . Algae turned the water green at the same time. Prosecutors blamed the rush to finish before July Fourth in a court filing . "Hasty and botched work" resulted from that rush, the filing said. A National Park Service engineer had warned the administration on June 11, NBC News reported. "[T]op layer of liner has peeled," the engineer wrote in an email. Prosecutors dropped the case against former Olympic canoeist David Hearn for alleged vandalism, then moved to dismiss charges against three other people, NPR reported . President Donald Trump rejected the botched-work finding on Aug. 1 and turned on U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro , who reached it, according to NBC. "There may have been some contractor difficulty, but the major damage was caused by VANDALS!" the president wrote on Truth Social. Interior Secretary Doug Burgum handed the repair back to the same firm that did the original work, he told CNN . That contractor won the job without competing bids. "We'll use the same company, because they did a fantastic job," Burgum insisted.
